R-1.name: co-located match, thermally isolated from the ICP bracket, with its own radiator
R-1.why_no_dcr: DBF1-RF-03 (match on / immediately adjacent to the ICP module, match_colocated = true) and the DBF1-TH-01 node set are unchanged; the match mounting conductance, the match radiator area and the match-to-antenna lead are design-completion values that are not DBF-1 values (DCR_PROCESS.md 'What is not a design change')

network_edits.L_MA_MO: G_W_K replaced by G_iso (thermal isolator standoffs, below)
network_edits.S_MA: area_m2 replaced by A_MA (design lever, grid below); surface, enclosure E_MATCH (zenith, views SPACE only), optics (Z-93 class alpha 0.17 / eps 0.92) unchanged
network_edits.L_MA_ANT: NEW LUMPED_G link N_MATCH - N_ANTENNA with G_lead (the RF output lead from the match to the antenna terminals). The P7 v1 network has no such link; a co-located match needs one, so R-1 carries it (conservative for the match). It adds no node
network_edits.N_MATCH mass: unchanged (0.8 kg): the radiator mass is reported, not added to the node; less thermal mass is conservative for both the hot-orbit maximum and the cold-orbit minimum

G_iso.quantity: match box to ICP bracket conductance through thermal-isolator standoffs
G_iso.design: four Ti-6Al-4V tubular standoffs, OD 8 mm, wall 1 mm (A = 22.0 mm^2 each), free length 30 mm (assumed design values)
G_iso.derivation: G = 4 k A / L with k = 7.37 W/(m K) at 293.15 K -> 0.0216 W/K (nominal 0.022). Upper end 0.04: k(T) rise of Ti-6Al-4V toward the 480 K bracket side (factor ~1.4, from memory, verify) and +25 % geometry / tolerance. Lower end 0.012: series contact resistance at both standoff ends (factor ~0.55, assumed)

sources.pointer: /material_properties (Ti6Al4V k 7.37 W/(m K) at 293.15 K, EXT-NIST-CRYO curve fit, measured)

G_iso.validation_status: NOT_VALIDATED; EM verification: measured standoff conductance

G_lead.quantity: conductance of the RF output lead pair, match to antenna terminals
G_lead.design: two conductors, each a copper-plated 304 stainless tube, OD 6.35 mm, wall 0.5 mm, copper plating 60 um (>= 3 skin depths: delta_Cu = 17.7 um at 13.56 MHz), length 0.10 m (assumed design values; a plated-stainless thermal-break RF lead)
G_lead.derivation: per conductor (k_Cu A_Cu + k_SS A_SS) / L = (396.9 x 1.197e-6 + 15.13 x 9.19e-6) / 0.10 = 6.14e-3 W/K; pair 0.0123 W/K. Upper end 0.025: plating up to 2x nominal thickness and k_SS(T) x 1.3 toward the antenna end (from memory, verify). Lower end 0.010 (0.8 x nominal, tolerance)

sources.pointer: /material_properties (OFHC copper 396.9, SS304 15.13 W/(m K) at 293.15 K, EXT-NIST-CRYO)

G_lead.validation_status: NOT_VALIDATED; EM verification: lead conductance and RF resistance

f_lead.quantity: RF ohmic loss of the lead pair as a fraction of the power delivered to the antenna
f_lead.derivation: f_lead = 2 R_lead / R_A with R_lead = rho_Cu L / (pi d delta_Cu) = 1.68e-8 x 0.10 / (pi x 6.35e-3 x 17.7e-6) = 4.76 mOhm per conductor; R_A from R-2 R_A range; at R_A = 0.5 Ohm f_lead = 0.019, at the reference 1 Ohm 0.0095. The uniformly generated lead loss splits half to each end; half is deposited on N_MATCH
f_lead.evidence_class: model-derived on assumed geometry; rho_Cu 1.68e-8 Ohm m from memory (verify)

Q_match_frac_R1.derivation: the P7 registered match loss 0.05 of P_fwd (thermal_load_inputs_v2 /icp/Q_match_frac, assumed, verify P2) plus half the lead loss: 0.05 + 0.019 / 2 = 0.0595 -> 0.06 at the hot corner; 0.05 + 0.0095 / 2 -> 0.055 nominal; 0.05 (lead loss neglected, less heat) in the cold corners. Applied by editing icp.Q_match_frac of the load inputs in the R-1 runs only

design_lever.mass_basis: radiator mass reported at 4 kg/m^2 (the R_HALL basis of P7 prereg nodes / R_HALL) plus standoffs 4 x 30 mm x 22.0 mm^2 Ti-6Al-4V (density 4430 kg/m^3, from memory, verify)

HOT.use: every hot case (TC1-TC4, TC7, S1), the grid search, the confirmation, the allowable and the T_SC sensitivity

NOMINAL.use: TC1 and TC3 reported only (never used to select or to pass)

COLD.use: TC5 and TC6 at each of the four (G_iso, G_lead) combinations; the governing cold result is the lowest T_min and the largest heater over the four

procedure: 1. Grid: for each A_MA in ascending order, steady TC1 and TC3 at the HOT corner; record N_MATCH T and every node T.

2. Selection: the smallest A_MA whose N_MATCH T <= 60 degC in TC1 and TC3 (and every node with a registered upper limit still passes); confirmed with periodic TC2 and TC4 at the HOT corner; if a confirmation fails, the next grid point in order. No feasible confirmed point -> R-1 not admissible, and the point that maximises the N_MATCH margin is carried and reported.

3. At the selected A_MA: every registered case at the HOT corner (hot) and the four COLD corners (TC5, TC6); heater sizing on N_MATCH per P7 prereg /solver_initial/heater_sizing (bisection, [0, 200] W) at each cold corner.

4. Reported: AL-QMATCH = the largest Q_match_frac keeping N_MATCH <= 60 degC in TC3 (steady) at the HOT corner and the selected A_MA (bisection on [0, 0.5], 0.0005); T_SC sensitivity; NOMINAL-corner TC1 / TC3.

R-2.name: match relocated to the RF-generator side (match_colocated = false)
dbf1_items: DBF1-RF-03 -> remote match at the RF generator (match_colocated = false)
R-2.network_edits: N_MATCH, its surface S_MA, enclosure E_MATCH and links L_MA_MO, L_MA_PPU removed; model.match_colocated = false; the N_MATCH limit is not evaluated. The thermal model books Q_icp_match_W and P_icp_matching_DC_W at B_PPU_RF RF_CHAIN (NP-THERMAL 2.0.0 deposition rule TK-04 / TK-05)
R-2.module_loads: identical to P7 v2 (the same power delivered to the antenna; Q_line_frac 0 on the module): the line loss of the remote match is carried by the RF-chain penalty and the RF_GENERATOR unit below, never as reduced module heating

rf_penalty_model.relation: a 50-Ohm coaxial line of matched loss ML [dB] = alpha l terminated by the unmatched antenna Z_A = R_A + j X_A delivers P_L / P_in = a (1 - |G|^2) / (a^2 - |G|^2), a = 10^(ML / 10), G = (Z_A - 50) / (Z_A + 50) (standard transmission-line relation for loss with load mismatch, e.g. ARRL Antenna Book transmission-line chapter; from memory, verify). With the match at the generator: P_delivered = P_fwd (1 - f_match) eta_line, so the same delivered power needs P_fwd,R2 = P_fwd,R1 / eta_line with P_fwd,R1 the co-located forward power

X_A.derivation: X_A = 2 pi f L_A, L_A from Wheeler's single-layer coil formula L[uH] = r^2 N^2 / (9 r + 10 l) (r, l in inches; H. A. Wheeler, Proc. IRE 16 (1928) 1398, from memory, verify) for the P7 antenna geometry (3 turns, 6 mm copper tube, r = 75 mm; thermal_cases_prereg_v1 /nodes N_ANTENNA, assumed) with an assumed 12 mm pitch (l = 36 mm): L_A = 1.926 uH, X_A = 164.1 Ohm
X_A.range_basis: geometry not frozen (F6-X-06 N_ant, F6-X-09 d_ant TBD) and plasma loading lowers the effective inductance (from memory, verify)

R_A_Ohm.evidence_class: assumed (plasma-loaded 13.56 MHz ICP antenna resistance class; from memory, verify); the antenna impedance is TBD_AFTER_IMPEDANCE_MAP (P2)

alpha_dB_per_m.evidence_class: assumed (flexible 50-Ohm space-qualified coax at 13.56 MHz; from memory, verify)

length_m.evidence_class: assumed (RF generator on the spacecraft-side radiator to the ICP module; REFERENCE_PENDING_ICD)

operating_points.anchor: P_fwd,R1 = 200 W (icp.P_fwd_anchor_W, HOT_H / COLD_OP / P6 reference)

rf_penalty_model.power: dP_fwd = P_fwd,R2 - P_fwd,R1; dP_bus = dP_fwd x (dP_bus / dP_fwd of the P6 RF trade line); dP_d,max = dP_fwd x (dP_d,max / dP_fwd of the trade line, design allocation 1,350 W)

R-2.rf_generator_unit: the P7 boundary-unit rule (prereg /boundary_units) for RF_GENERATOR with the relocated match and line booked there: dissipation = P_fwd,R2 (1 / eta_RF - 1) + P_refl + f_match P_fwd,R2 + P_matching_DC + (1 - f_match) P_fwd,R2 (1 - eta_line) (the whole line loss on the generator side: conservative for the unit); reported at the REFERENCE and CONSERVATIVE corners against the v2 400 W / 1.099 m^2

R-1 admissible iff: R1-a: a feasible, confirmed A_MA exists and at it every governing hot case (TC1-TC4) converges with N_MATCH T_max <= 60 degC at the HOT corner

R1-b: TC5 and TC6 converge at all four COLD corners and N_MATCH reaches its -20 / -40 degC lower limits with a sized heater (<= 200 W bisection range); the operating heater (TC5) bus power is compared with the P6 thermal_control slot (4.0 W at P-NOM) and any excess is reported as a P6 penalty (not a gate)

R1-c: no node with a registered upper limit that PASSES in thermal_closure_v2 FAILS (HOT corner, every governing hot case); no P8 materials DCR trigger fires; REQUIREMENT_ONLY capabilities and Q into the spacecraft are reported with their change from v2

R1-d: the RF-chain power penalty is reported against the P6 margins: the lead loss at the reference R_A (1 Ohm) and the conservative R_A (0.5 Ohm) as dP_fwd for the same delivered power at the anchor, converted with the P6 trade-line slopes; plus the operating heater
R-2 admissible iff: R2-a: every governing case converges with N_MATCH absent; no node with a registered upper limit that PASSES in v2 FAILS; no P8 trigger fires

R2-b: at the CONSERVATIVE corner the forward power for the anchor delivered power, P_fwd,R2 = 200 W / eta_line, stays within the DBF1-RF-02 envelope end 500 W (otherwise R-2 also needs a DBF1-RF-02 change)

R2-c: at the CONSERVATIVE corner the bus penalty dP_bus at the anchor stays within the P-NOM margin to the 1,500 W RFP ceiling (150 W in power_ledger_v1); the REFERENCE-corner dP_bus and dP_d,max are reported
criteria.no_retuning: the ranges, corners, grid and criteria above are not changed after any route result is seen; a change is a v2 preregistration with the reason

selection_rule: R-1 if R-1 is admissible (DCR-DBF1-003 is then WITHDRAWN: no DBF-1 value changes; the match isolation, radiator and lead become registered design-completion values for a P7 load-input / network version); otherwise R-2 if R-2 is admissible (DCR-DBF1-003 proceeds as DBF-1.1 for the coordinator); otherwise BLOCKED with the residual (the N_MATCH shortfall of R-1 and the failed R-2 criterion with its quantity)
p7_state_rule: the P7 closure-state precedence of thermal_cases_prereg_v1 /closure_state_rule is applied to the selected route: DCR REQUIRED only if a limited node still fails; REFERENCE/ICD DEPENDENT when Q into the spacecraft exceeds the 50 W governing allocation or the T_SC sensitivity changes a verdict; FROZEN FOR EM when every limited node passes and the rest are EM verification requirements; CLOSED is not reachable (NOT_VALIDATED model, PARAMETRIC cases)
